issues.fix_hint: Review each quoted href as written: a truncated or malformed URL passes no crawl equity and often signals a broken template; a non-http(s) scheme is only a finding when the link was meant to be a page. Recording is opt-in (discovery.record_invalid_targets); rejected targets never enter the crawl.
issues.message: The page points at hrefs that cannot become fetchable link targets (unparsable syntax or a non-http(s) scheme)
